scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Pichhda Varg Evam Ati Pichhda Varg Kaushal Vikas Prashikshan Yojana
department: Backward Classes and Extremely Backward Classes Welfare Department
description: The Mukhyamantri Pichhda Varg Evam Ati Pichhda Varg Kaushal Vikas Prashikshan Yojana is implemented by the Backward Classes and Extremely Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Bihar. The scheme aims to improve the employability and income-generating capacity of youth belonging to the Backward Class (BC) and Extremely Backward Class (EBC) communities through free domain-specific skill development training. Training is conducted through Bihar Skill Development Mission (BSDM) approved Skill Development Centres (SDCs), enabling beneficiaries to secure employment or become self-employed.
objectives: Enhance the employability of BC and EBC youth.
Promote self-employment opportunities through skill development.
Provide free industry-oriented skill development training.
Improve income generation through certification and placement support.

benefits.title: Free Skill Training
benefits.description: Free domain-specific skill development training in multiple industry sectors.

benefits.title: Industry Certification
benefits.description: Certificate is issued after successful completion of training and assessment.

benefits.title: Placement Support
benefits.description: Support for employment and self-employment is provided after successful completion of training.

eligibility.title: Residence
eligibility.description: The applicant must be a resident of Bihar.

eligibility.title: Category
eligibility.description: The applicant must belong to the Backward Class (BC) or Extremely Backward Class (EBC).

eligibility.title: Age Limit
eligibility.description: The applicant must be between 18 and 45 years of age.

eligibility.title: Aadhaar Requirement
eligibility.description: The applicant must possess a valid Aadhaar number.

registration_steps.title: Visit BSDM Website
registration_steps.description: Visit the official Bihar Skill Development Mission (BSDM) website.

registration_steps.title: Choose Training Centre
registration_steps.description: Search for the nearest BSDM-approved Skill Development Centre (SDC) and select the desired course.

registration_steps.title: Prepare Documents
registration_steps.description: Collect and self-attest all required supporting documents.

application_steps.title: Visit Training Centre
application_steps.description: Visit the selected Skill Development Centre for document verification and registration.

application_steps.title: Portal Registration
application_steps.description: The Skill Development Centre uploads the applicant's details on the BSDM portal.

application_steps.title: Aadhaar Verification
application_steps.description: The applicant's Aadhaar details are digitally verified.

application_steps.title: Batch Approval
application_steps.description: After successful verification, the applicant is included in a training batch approved by the Bihar State Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation.

application_steps.title: Training Begins
application_steps.description: Training is conducted by certified trainers at the Skill Development Centre.

documents_required.name: Other Supporting Documents
documents_required.remarks: Any additional documents required by the department.

important_notes: Training is completely free for eligible candidates.
Training is conducted only through BSDM-approved Skill Development Centres (SDCs).
Each training batch consists of a minimum of 20 and a maximum of 40 candidates.
Successful candidates receive certification after assessment.
Placement and self-employment support is provided after successful completion of the training.

faqs.question: Who can apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Residents of Bihar belonging to the BC or EBC category who are between 18 and 45 years of age.

faqs.question: Is the training free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The training is provided free of cost.

faqs.question: Where is the training conducted?
faqs.answer: Training is conducted through BSDM-approved Skill Development Centres (SDCs).

faqs.question: Does the scheme provide placement support?
faqs.answer: Yes. Placement and self-employment support is provided after successful completion of the training.
